belief_fit: discovery prompts of one regime, train directions, primary alphas, frozen layers
decision_order: split, finiteness, or discovery self-check fails -> INCONCLUSIVE
does_not: choose a new multiplier after scoring
model: frozen Qwen measurements from the CCSO run
question: Using a belief stored from discovery prompts of one regime, does an unchanged-context measurement hold, does a regime change revise scope when the stored effect misses, and does an unseen direction block the update?
regime_change: all ordered pairs of regimes; mixed pair labels become MIXED
same_regime_prompts: validation and replication of that regime
scope_string_alone: Same-regime numbers with a scope string that only adds '::label-only'.

tolerance.std: ddof=0 of Δ/α on discovery prompts, primary alphas, one intervention

two_changes: Regime-changed records plus novel directions. A novel direction has no stored prediction, so the existing undefined-intervention rule abstains.
